# Erlex v0.2.9 - Table of Contents

> Convert Erlang style structs and error messages to equivalent Elixir.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://erlex.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Erlex](https://erlex.hexdocs.pm/Erlex.md): Convert Erlang style structs and error messages to equivalent Elixir.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix erlex.typecheck](https://erlex.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Erlex.Typecheck.md): Runs Erlang's Dialyzer directly via the `:dialyzer` module.
